_comment: Stream picker contents. Edited here, not in index.html/iframe.html - the page
reads this file at startup, so a changed line-up needs no rebuild of app.bundle.js.
The first profile whose 'hosts' matches the browser's hostname wins, so the same
file can be deployed to every environment unchanged. Patterns are exact names or
a trailing '*' wildcard; '*' on its own matches anything, so keep the catch-all
profile last. Override the choice for testing with ?streams=<id>.
Item fields: 'label' and 'url'; 'newTab': true opens it in a tab instead of
playing it (control panels); { "separator": true } draws the divider rule.
{host} in a url is replaced with the hostname the page was served from, so
the local profile follows the machine it runs on and needs no edit when that
machine's address changes. Write a literal address instead to pin it.
A file holding a single environment works too - give it a top level "items"
array and leave "profiles" out. If this file is missing or malformed the picker
silently falls back to the <option> list baked into the HTML.
